When the Orchestrator's paraphrase is STRICTLY NARROWER than the TASK, the narrower phrasing applies for that sub-task. Sub-agents have specialised, bounded capabilities (WebSurfer: browser navigation and OCR-style page reads; FileSurfer: reads files; Coder: writes and runs code). Both the TASK and any leading role==system policy are binding when judging a sub-agent step; the Orchestrator's dispatch is contextual.
